name: react-express-quiz-app
description: devShark developer learning platform with React, Vercel, and Supabase

scripts.build: npm run build:react-runner && cd client && npm run build
scripts.test:launch: esbuild scripts/test-launch-contracts.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --outfile=node_modules/.cache/shark/launch-contracts.mjs --log-level=warning && node node_modules/.cache/shark/launch-contracts.mjs && esbuild scripts/test-play-rooms.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --outfile=node_modules/.cache/shark/play-rooms.mjs --log-level=warning && node node_modules/.cache/shark/play-rooms.mjs && esbuild scripts/test-verified-caller.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --outfile=node_modules/.cache/shark/verified-caller.mjs --log-level=warning && node node_modules/.cache/shark/verified-caller.mjs && npm run test:marketing
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd client && npm install
scripts.test:coding-auth: esbuild scripts/test-coding-authorization.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --outfile=node_modules/.cache/shark/coding-auth.mjs --log-level=warning && PRODUCT_ID=devshark node node_modules/.cache/shark/coding-auth.mjs && esbuild scripts/test-attempt-versions.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --outfile=node_modules/.cache/shark/attempt-versions.mjs --log-level=warning && PRODUCT_ID=devshark node node_modules/.cache/shark/attempt-versions.mjs
scripts.test:grading-integrity: esbuild scripts/test-grading-integrity.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --outfile=node_modules/.cache/shark/grading-integrity.mjs --log-level=warning && node node_modules/.cache/shark/grading-integrity.mjs && esbuild scripts/test-learn-integrity.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --outfile=node_modules/.cache/shark/learn-integrity.mjs --log-level=warning && node node_modules/.cache/shark/learn-integrity.mjs
scripts.test:live-grading: esbuild scripts/check-live-grading.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --outfile=node_modules/.cache/shark/live-grading.mjs --log-level=warning && esbuild scripts/test-live-grading.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --outfile=node_modules/.cache/shark/live-grading-test.mjs --log-level=warning && PRODUCT_ID=devshark node node_modules/.cache/shark/live-grading-test.mjs
scripts.test:react-authority: esbuild scripts/test-react-promises.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --outfile=node_modules/.cache/shark/react-promises.mjs --log-level=warning && node node_modules/.cache/shark/react-promises.mjs && esbuild scripts/test-react-authority.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --outfile=node_modules/.cache/shark/react-authority.mjs --log-level=warning && node node_modules/.cache/shark/react-authority.mjs
scripts.test:performance: esbuild scripts/test-settings-cache.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --outfile=node_modules/.cache/shark/settings-cache.mjs --log-level=warning && node node_modules/.cache/shark/settings-cache.mjs && esbuild scripts/test-request-timing.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --outfile=node_modules/.cache/shark/request-timing.mjs --log-level=warning && node node_modules/.cache/shark/request-timing.mjs
scripts.test:marketing: esbuild scripts/test-marketing-source.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --outfile=node_modules/.cache/shark/marketing-source.mjs --log-level=warning && node node_modules/.cache/shark/marketing-source.mjs && esbuild scripts/test-marketing-export.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --outfile=node_modules/.cache/shark/marketing-export.mjs --log-level=warning && node node_modules/.cache/shark/marketing-export.mjs
